contract: RE-SHARED-IMPL.md (signatures exact; B1a = spacewarp_est.h/.cpp, swp_shaders.h, swp_est_worker.cpp, tests/)
mv_units: RGBA16F, rg = uv displacement = NDC delta / 2 (contract's v.xy/scale with scale = 2.0), ba = 0

mv_gen: h1 (median seed + 3x3 refine + parabolic subpel -> final uv map)
extrapolate: single-texture backward warp: dst(q) = src(q + mv*fovScale*(1 - scaleFactor)), clampMagnitude then sr.mode/sr.radius stretch then uv clamp

constants_conservative.mv_default: input/2 clamped to >= 64 (brief); explicit values honored when 8 <= size <= 2048

expected_outcomes.name: swp_sad_frag (direct, QCOM as-is)
expected_outcomes.probe: SWP_SAD macro pointed at a plain-GLSL stub -> exit 0

shader_syntax.note: glslang 1.x rejects GL_QCOM_block_match (reproduced on this toolchain 2026-10-17). The device-side compile path is exercised by the parent's NDK build; the dialect probe validates all grammar except the QCOM builtin itself.

math_test.description: pure-python mirror of the GLSL loop shapes on deterministic synthetic frames (noise luma for matching, linear ramp for warp-exact assertions)

expected_cases.name: gme_on_grid_exact
expected_cases.expect: coarse GME returns the (+4,-4) candidate exactly (SAD 0 unique)

expected_cases.name: median_preserves_constant_field
expected_cases.expect: median of a constant field == the field

expected_cases.name: subpel_structural_bound_fractional
expected_cases.expect: for truth 2.5, refined lands in [1.5, 3.5] texels (winner integer +- 0.5 parabola; integer SADs tie on white noise by expectation)

expected_cases.name: extrapolate_time_shifted_warp
expected_cases.expect: dst(center) == linear-sample of src at shift mv*(1-1.5), exact on the ramp frame

expected_cases.name: clamp_magnitude_bounds_offset
expected_cases.expect: mv=9uv with sf=2 clamps the sample offset to -clamp_mag exactly

expected_cases.name: sr_mode0_stretch_ramp
expected_cases.expect: border pixel sampled at u + d*min(room/radius,1) exactly

expected_cases.name: sr_mode0_band_attenuates
expected_cases.expect: attenuation factor < 1 inside the border band

statuses.8: QCOM ext missing => plain-SAD fallback armed (sticky)
statuses.32: estimator budget exceeded during the last call

documented_gaps: guided filter refinement (VD @0x57856) - out of scope per RE-SHARED-IMPL.md
temporal motion statistics + scene-change detection - out of scope
TFLite 'Smart' global-motion stage - out of scope (GME = our own strided-lattice SAD approximation)
MV-direction convention is estimator-internal (forward flow prev->curr at prev positions); re-verify XR_FB_space_warp runtime expectations before any runtime MotionVectorSubImage attach

VD per-pixel ME_Warp/ME_FrameExtrapolationStereo shader semantics are only partially decoded (REPORT.md §8); we pinned a conservative single-texture backward warp in uv space plus sf-anchored time shifting
